lines: This plan covers 7 days, starting today.
For today, breakfast and lunch are off the plan: the day is already under way.
The shared dish is vegan: that is what Malo eats.
Yanis misses meals on Saturday and Wednesday: those shares are not counted.
Camille has not said what they need: their share is served like the table's.
The shares in this plan are served at the plate, as close as they can be, rather than adjusted mouth by mouth.

dishes.name: Saturday lentil supper
dishes.title: Lentils, courgette and couscous
dishes.method: Reheat the lentil and vegetable portion, cover the couscous with boiling water, then finish with lemon.
dishes.why: A warm, plant-based supper using colourful summer vegetables and a quick grain.

dishes.name: Anouk's chicken supper
dishes.title: Chicken, courgette and couscous
dishes.method: Take Anouk's sealed chicken portion first from the clean preparation, add the couscous and lemon, and close the box before serving.
dishes.why: A simple chicken supper with seasonal vegetables and a quick grain.

dishes.name: Tofu berry breakfast
dishes.title: Tofu scramble, toast and berries
dishes.method: Reheat the tofu scramble, toast the bread and serve with raspberries.
dishes.why: A regular breakfast built around plant protein and fresh French summer fruit.

dishes.name: Anouk's berry yoghurt
dishes.title: Greek yoghurt, toast and berries
dishes.method: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl, toast the bread and add the raspberries.
dishes.why: A fresh, uncomplicated breakfast with yoghurt, whole grains and seasonal fruit.

dishes.name: Lentil salad bowl
dishes.title: Lentils, tomato, cucumber and couscous
dishes.method: Reheat the lentil portion, prepare the couscous, chop the cucumber and finish with lemon.
dishes.why: A lighter summer version of the batch, with crisp vegetables for contrast.

dishes.name: Anouk's chicken salad
dishes.title: Chicken, tomato, cucumber and couscous
dishes.method: Use the sealed chicken portion, prepare the couscous, chop the cucumber and serve.
dishes.why: A cool chicken salad that suits a warm summer lunchtime.

dishes.name: Herby lentil plate
dishes.title: Lentils, roasted peppers and couscous
dishes.method: Reheat the lentils and vegetables, prepare the couscous and fold through the roasted pepper.
dishes.why: The same batch becomes a different plate with sweet roasted pepper and herbs.

dishes.name: Anouk's pepper chicken
dishes.title: Chicken, roasted pepper and couscous
dishes.method: Take the sealed chicken portion first, add pepper and couscous, and close the box.
dishes.why: A warm chicken plate with sweet pepper and a quick grain.

dishes.name: Tofu toast breakfast
dishes.title: Tofu scramble, toast and peach
dishes.method: Reheat the tofu scramble, toast the bread and serve with sliced peach.
dishes.why: A dependable breakfast using the prepared protein and ripe summer fruit.

dishes.name: Anouk's peach yoghurt
dishes.title: Greek yoghurt, toast and peach
dishes.method: Spoon yoghurt into a bowl, toast the bread and slice over the peach.
dishes.why: A quick breakfast with protein and fruit that needs no batch cooking.

dishes.name: Lentil couscous lunch
dishes.title: Lentils, courgette and couscous
dishes.method: Reheat the last lentil portion and prepare the couscous alongside it.
dishes.why: A practical final meal from the Saturday preparation, without another cooking session.

dishes.name: Anouk's last chicken lunch
dishes.title: Chicken, courgette and couscous
dishes.method: Use the sealed chicken portion, prepare the couscous and serve with the vegetables.
dishes.why: A quick final chicken lunch from the Saturday cooking session.

dishes.name: Tuesday bean bowl
dishes.title: White beans, tomato, aubergine and quinoa
dishes.method: Reheat the bean and vegetable portion and add the cooked quinoa.
dishes.why: A fresh batch starts the second part of the week with legumes and seasonal aubergine.

dishes.name: Anouk's bean-free chicken
dishes.title: Chicken, tomato, aubergine and quinoa
dishes.method: Make Anouk's chicken portion first on clean equipment, then add quinoa and vegetables and close the box.
dishes.why: A separate chicken plate prepared safely alongside the plant-based batch.

dishes.name: Wednesday tofu breakfast
dishes.title: Tofu scramble, toast and melon
dishes.method: Reheat the tofu scramble, toast the bread and serve with melon.
dishes.why: A regular, refreshing breakfast that keeps the morning simple.

dishes.name: Anouk's melon yoghurt
dishes.title: Greek yoghurt, toast and melon
dishes.method: Serve the yoghurt with toasted bread and sliced melon.
dishes.why: A cool breakfast with protein and fruit for a warm day.

dishes.name: Bean quinoa salad
dishes.title: White beans, tomato, cucumber and quinoa
dishes.method: Reheat the bean portion, add quinoa and cucumber, and serve.
dishes.why: A crisp salad-style variation that uses the batch while it is fresh.

dishes.name: Anouk's chicken quinoa salad
dishes.title: Chicken, tomato, cucumber and quinoa
dishes.method: Take the sealed chicken portion first, add quinoa and cucumber, and close the box.
dishes.why: A fresh chicken-and-quinoa salad for a busy midday meal.

dishes.name: Aubergine bean supper
dishes.title: White beans, aubergine, tomato and quinoa
dishes.method: Reheat the bean and aubergine portion and serve with quinoa.
dishes.why: A warm, plant-based supper using the second-day batch.

dishes.name: Anouk's aubergine chicken
dishes.title: Chicken, aubergine, tomato and quinoa
dishes.method: Take the sealed chicken portion first, add the vegetables and quinoa, and close the box.
dishes.why: A comforting but summery chicken supper with aubergine.

dishes.name: Thursday tofu breakfast
dishes.title: Tofu scramble, toast and apricot
dishes.method: Reheat the tofu scramble, toast the bread and serve with apricots.
dishes.why: A straightforward protein breakfast with seasonal stone fruit.

dishes.name: Anouk's apricot yoghurt
dishes.title: Greek yoghurt, toast and apricots
dishes.method: Serve yoghurt with toasted bread and sliced apricots.
dishes.why: A fresh, quick breakfast with yoghurt and ripe fruit.

dishes.name: Thursday bean plate
dishes.title: White beans, courgette, tomato and quinoa
dishes.method: Reheat the bean portion, quickly soften the courgette in a pan and add quinoa.
dishes.why: A final varied serving of the bean batch with fresh courgette.

dishes.name: Anouk's courgette chicken
dishes.title: Chicken, courgette, tomato and quinoa
dishes.method: Take the sealed chicken portion first, add courgette and quinoa, and close the box.
dishes.why: A quick final chicken lunch from Tuesday's preparation.

dishes.name: Friday tofu breakfast
dishes.title: Tofu scramble, toast and grapes
dishes.method: Reheat the tofu scramble, toast the bread and serve with grapes.
dishes.why: A quick end-of-week breakfast with plant protein and fresh fruit.

dishes.name: Anouk's grape yoghurt
dishes.title: Greek yoghurt, toast and grapes
dishes.method: Serve yoghurt with toasted bread and grapes.
dishes.why: A no-fuss breakfast with protein and fresh fruit.

dishes.name: Friday lentil bowl
dishes.title: Lentils, tomato, courgette and quinoa
dishes.method: Reheat the lentil and vegetable portion and add the cooked quinoa.
dishes.why: A newly cooked batch makes Friday lunch easy and varied.

dishes.name: Anouk's Friday chicken
dishes.title: Chicken, tomato, courgette and quinoa
dishes.method: Take the sealed chicken portion first, add quinoa and vegetables, and close the box.
dishes.why: A freshly prepared chicken lunch that stays simple at the end of the week.

dishes.name: Friday tomato lentils
dishes.title: Lentils, tomato, peppers and quinoa
dishes.method: Reheat the lentils, add the roasted pepper and serve with quinoa.
dishes.why: A colourful plant-based dinner made from Friday's short batch.

dishes.name: Anouk's pepper chicken
dishes.title: Chicken, tomato, peppers and quinoa
dishes.method: Take the sealed chicken portion first, add pepper and quinoa, and close the box.
dishes.why: A colourful chicken dinner from Friday's cooking session.

preparations.title: Saturday lentil vegetables
preparations.method: Cook the courgettes and tomatoes in olive oil, stir through the lentils, season, cool promptly and portion into the named boxes.

preparations.title: Saturday roast chicken vegetables
preparations.method: On clean equipment, roast the chicken and vegetables first, portion and close Anouk's box before preparing any other batch.

preparations.title: Sunday tofu scramble
preparations.method: Crumble tofu, soften the onions in oil, cook together until hot, cool quickly and portion for Sunday and Monday breakfasts.

preparations.title: Tuesday bean vegetables
preparations.method: Roast the aubergines while softening the tomatoes, fold in the beans, cool promptly and portion.

preparations.title: Tuesday chicken vegetables
preparations.method: Cook Anouk's chicken first on washed equipment with fresh oil, portion and close the box, then wash everything before the bean batch.

preparations.title: Tuesday tofu scramble
preparations.method: Crumble tofu, cook it with softened onions and oil, cool promptly and portion for Tuesday to Thursday breakfasts.

preparations.title: Friday lentil vegetables
preparations.method: Cook the courgettes and tomatoes in oil, fold in the lentils, cool promptly and portion for Friday lunch and dinner.

preparations.title: Friday chicken vegetables
preparations.method: Cook Anouk's chicken first on clean equipment with fresh oil, portion and close the box before preparing the lentils.

preparations.title: Friday tofu scramble
preparations.method: Crumble tofu, cook it with softened onions and oil, cool promptly and portion for Friday breakfast.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Heat the oven, cook Anouk's chicken and vegetables first on clean equipment, portion and close her box, wash the equipment, cook the lentil vegetables, then cook the tofu scramble; cool each batch promptly and portion into the named boxes.

Start Anouk's chicken first on clean equipment with fresh oil, portion and close her boxes, wash board, knife, pan and worktop, roast the aubergines, cook the bean vegetables, then cook the tofu scramble; cool and portion into the named boxes.
